ownership_model.kernel: core/src/semantic/ownership.rs: OwnershipKind (BorrowShared/BorrowMut/MoveOrCopy real; Acquire/Release/Transfer/Escape declared, never emitted), OwnershipResolution (Resolved/Unresolved, added this pass), OwnershipIdentity { repository, revision, function, name, span, kind, resolution }.
ownership_model.scope_this_wave: `&expr`/`&mut expr` is fully syntax-determined -> BorrowShared/BorrowMut, always Observed. A bare identifier used by value at a genuine value position (call/method-call argument, let/assignment RHS, struct/array/tuple literal field/element, range bound, break value, return value, or a genuine tail-position chain back to the function body) -> MoveOrCopy, always Observed (the fact that a by-value use occurred is syntax-determined; whether it moves or copies is not, and is never guessed). Acquire/Release/Transfer/Escape and allocation/free are declared but never emitted -- would require resolving an overloaded call to a specific known API, the same problem R4.8 EFFECT already declined to solve without fabricating semantics.
ownership_model.identity_key_design: identity_key() covers repository/revision/function/name/span/kind. `resolution` is deliberately excluded, mirroring R4.8's StateResolution precedent -- it is a resolution fact about an already-identified operation, not part of what makes the operation itself distinct.
